verses.text: Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

segments.text: Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry;
Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

verses.text: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes look upon equity.

segments.text: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence;
Let thine eyes look upon equity.

verses.text: Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

segments.text: Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited me in the night;
Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing;
I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

verses.text: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.

segments.text: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips
I have kept me from the ways of the violent.

verses.text: My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.

segments.text: My steps have held fast to thy paths,
My feet have not slipped.

verses.text: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

segments.text: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God:

and

verses.text: Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that take refuge in thee From those that rise up against them.

verses.text: Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

segments.text: Keep me as the apple of the eye;
Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

verses.text: From the wicked that oppress me, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.

segments.text: From the wicked that oppress me,
My deadly enemies, that compass me about.

verses.text: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.

segments.text: They are inclosed in their own fat:
With their mouth they speak proudly.

verses.text: They have now compassed us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

segments.text: They have now compassed us in our steps;

verses.text: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

segments.text: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey,

verses.text: Arise, O Jehovah, Confront him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked by thy sword;

verses.text: From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

verses.text: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with beholding thy form.
